{{Top}}
A '''macrofuser''' was a small welding tool designed for repairing complex metals,<ref name="Showdown in Mos Eisley">''[[Star Wars Missions 10: Showdown in Mos Eisley]]''</ref> such as those found in [[Starship/Legends|starships]].
